subject: Quick 20-min Ignite session to review your usage spike
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Park <sarah@Nimbus.ai>, Tom Riley <tom@Nimbus.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Aug 2029 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick 20-min Ignite session to review your usage spike

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Congrats on the recent activity spike — our system shows your team crossed the self-serve threshold this week. I wanted to offer a short, focused 20-minute Ignite session so we can: 
- walk through the telemetry we see (token patterns + peak windows),
- suggest quick config wins (batching and caching tweaks), and
- answer any questions on Dedicated vs hosted cost profiles.

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Monday 8/26 11:00–11:20
- Monday 8/26 14:00–14:20
- Tuesday 8/27 09:30–09:50

If none of those work, drop a couple times and I’ll sync Ben (solutions) to join for the technical bits. Attached is a short one-pager agenda so you know what to expect.

Quick note on privacy: this session will only review usage metadata — we won’t bring up any customer text.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
SDR, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0117
Redwood Inference

Attachment: ignite-agenda.pdf (PDF, 45KB stub)
From: Sarah Park <sarah@Nimbus.ai>

Cc: Tom Riley <tom@Nimbus.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Quick 20-min Ignite session to review your usage spike

Thanks, Soojin — this is perfect timing. We did a burst while testing a new ingestion pipeline. Tom and I can do Monday but the 11:00 slot conflicts with our weekly all-hands. 14:00 works for Tom; I have a hard stop at 14:25.

Can we aim for Monday 8/26 14:00–14:20? Also, please include Ben for the KV cache talk. If Ben isn’t available, Marissa is fine too.

— Sarah
VP Product, Nimbus Analytics
sarah@Nimbus.ai

- When: Mon, Aug 26, 2029 14:00–14:20 PDT
